text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Encountering Daiichi Ruby during an 
interview. Seeing her answer the call of 
her clan's expectations, Daitaku Helios...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying, "Isn't it total misery? Just ditch 
it!" she infuriated Daiichi Ruby, who felt 
her family pride had been insulted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios's vibe is totally killed. 
However, her Trainer-poo hypes her up with 
banging music, and she heads to the race 
on max energy!
